status_rule.entry: timed pitch with a scoreboard review and at least one confirmed field
status_rule.confirmed: reviewer's on-screen reading equals the recorded label
status_rule.mismatch: reviewer's reading differs from the label; reported as label_conflict, not evaluable
status_rule.unreadable: reviewer could not read that field in the decision frame; not evaluable
status_rule.occluded: no verified pre-delivery frame (timing status unavailable)
status_rule.scoreboard_unreviewed: timed pitch without a field-level scoreboard review
status_rule.no_confirmed_field: reviewed, but no field was both readable and equal to the label
status_rule.timing_unreviewed: manifest pitch without a timing row; counted in total_pitches only

entries.review_note: read from the ffmpeg frame grab at the decision frame
entries.timing_note: SNY full game. Bottom 3, Megill vs Harris II; 0-0 count, bases empty, 0 outs. At previous_grid_seconds 1894.00 the shot is a tight close-up of Harris holding the bat with the umpire behind him and no pitcher in frame, so condition 1 fails; the 1893.75 frame is the same close-up with the bug part-way through a white transition wipe ("EGILL :10", right half blank and no count/inning). The decision frame is 1894.25, the first frame of the live centre-field shot: Megill standing upright on the rubber, Harris in the screen-left (left-handed) box, catcher and umpire set, and the bug fully readable (NYM 0 / ATL 0, three empty diamonds, two empty out circles, down-arrow 3, 0-0, MEGILL :09 P:38). Continuity samples 1894.25, 1894.75, 1895.25, 1895.75, 1896.25, 1896.75 (max gap 0.50 s) are all the same live centre-field shot with the pitcher motionless on the rubber, hands together at the chest, and Harris in the box; the bug stays readable (:09 then :08, P:38, 0-0) with no step-off, time-out, cutaway or white wipe. Motion start is 1896.90, not 1897.00: at 1896.75 both feet are planted and the pitcher is still, at 1896.90 the back knee is flexing and the glove is rising into the lift, and by 1897.00 the lead foot is clearly off the ground. Release is later than my earlier 1897.90 claim, which was wrong: at 1897.85, 1897.90 and 1897.95 the glove arm points toward the plate while the throwing hand is still low and behind the hip in the arm swing with the stride foot in the air; at 1898.00 the throwing hand is up behind the head with the ball cocked; at 1898.05 the arm is coming over at cap level with the body turned so #38 faces the camera and the ball still at the hand; at 1898.10 the throwing arm is extended forward toward the plate with the hand open and empty; at 1898.15 the arm is into follow-through and a white ball is visible in flight in front of the catcher. Release is therefore bracketed by 1898.05 (pre-release) and 1898.10 (arm extended, ball gone), giving release_seconds 1898.10, which matches the verifier's suggestion and is outside my earlier value's +/-0.15 window. ffmpeg frame grabs; selected-frame review, not continuous playback. Manual timing, not frame-exact.

Megill takes the sign facing home through 1911.25 and turns sideways into the set position between 1911.25 and 1912.00 (a come-set from the stretch rather than a full windup, contrary to the task context's 'from the WINDUP'); that is a normal come-set and does not break the window. Motion start corrected to 1913.50: at 1913.00 and 1913.25 both feet are still flat on the rubber with no lift (only a slight weight shift at 1913.25), and 1913.50 is the first sampled frame with the front knee lifted high. At 1914.46 and 1914.48 the white ball is plainly visible in the hand cocked above and behind the cap. 1914.50 is a heavy motion blur of the forearm sweeping over the top across the cap with the hand still at head level. At 1914.52 the arm is extended up and forward past the head with the hand empty, and 1914.54, 1914.55 and 1914.56 show it extended further toward the plate with no ball at the hand. 1914.60, 1914.65, 1914.70 and 1914.80 are the follow-through, the arm sweeping down across the body with the trailing leg coming up. Release therefore bracketed by 1914.50 (ball still with the hand, arm coming over the top) and 1914.54 (arm extended forward, ball gone), giving release_seconds 1914.52. ffmpeg frame grabs; selected-frame review, not continuous playback.
